pages.text: The $(item)Battery Box$() stores 1,000,000 FE. The portable $(item)Battery$() holds 50,000 FE and powers machines from their battery slot when grid power runs out.

In the battery box window the top slot charges a battery and the bottom slot discharges it. The $(item)Charger$() has 4 slots and charges batteries, electric tools and FE items from other mods (1000 FE/t per slot).
